display.purpose: Expressive page titles and brief editorial moments.

body.purpose: Clear interface copy, forms, and navigation.

measure.purpose: Tabular metrics, durations, and measured values.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Separate cards from the page without visual heaviness.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Show menus, dialogs, and focused overlays above content.

motion.name: ease-standard

motion.name: duration-reveal

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Single high-priority action; compact label, violet signal, clear keyboard focus.
components.css: .vf-primary-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 14px/1.35 var(--font-body); transition: transform var(--duration-quick) var(--ease-standard), background-color var(--duration-quick) var(--ease-standard); } .vf-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Clearly labeled field with visible focus and validation states.
components.css: .vf-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-body); } .vf-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Activity Badge
components.description: Activity colors identify type and are always paired with a label or icon.
components.css: .vf-activity-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--activity-color) 14%, var(--surface)); color: var(--activity-color); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Label first, tabular value second, and compact context; avoid decorative charts.
components.css: .vf-card { padding: var(--space-6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .vf-metric-value { font: 600 40px/1.1 var(--font-measure); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Locked Feature
components.description: Explain what is locked, why, and the next step; never use color alone or a dead-end lock.
